artwork: I have tried to permanently subvert senses (all of them) to extreme ends where for a few moments reality would begin to die, the body would begin to wither, digits and limbs would begin to crawl backwards back into themselves -- petals of a flower at nightfall never to salute the sun again.  I have failed.  I have tried to solely breathe through my eyes -- seal my nostrils with a pinch, pucker my lips, and just see: inhaling the pastel arrangements of miscarried miscalculated imperfection in the everyday scenery with voyeuristic displeasure.  I have tried.  I have.  I have.  I have failed: To feel the lack
in a constant circumstance with so much

's.  To turn off the switch that powers the simulated environments.  To no longer hear the hum no longer heard (but now do).  To no longer stare at illuminated plastic and glass.  To no longer beat percussive thumbs in order to emote -- (ex)communicate.   To no longer confuse mobile chirps for what once upon a time was birdsong.  To no longer convert.  To no longer (un)zip.  To no longer load -- down, up, or otherwise. I have f a i l e d.
